haiku.problem: Not one of the passage's main questions. The father's core command, to keep away from the forbidden woman (card 1-9), has no trivia question, while this minor point about the LORD examining paths is asked instead.
The wrong answer 'A hunter's net' is a near-match to the right answer. The verse says the wicked man's sins are cords that entangle him, so a baker could argue the net is the same trap imagery.
